def merge_l(a, b):
    t0 = (a[1] + b[1])
    t1 = (((a[0] * a[1]) + (b[0] * b[1])) / t0)
    t2 = (((a[1] * a[2]) + (b[1] * b[2])) / t0)
    t3 = (((a[1] * a[3]) + (b[1] * b[3])) / t0)
    return (
        t1,  # c0
        t0,  # M
        t2,  # c1
        t3,  # c2
        (a[4] + b[4] + (((t3 - a[3]) * (t3 - a[3])) * a[1]) + (((t3 - b[3]) * (t3 - b[3])) * b[1]) + (((t2 - a[2]) * (t2 - a[2])) * a[1]) + (((t2 - b[2]) * (t2 - b[2])) * b[1]) + (((t1 - a[0]) * (t1 - a[0])) * a[1]) + (((t1 - b[0]) * (t1 - b[0])) * b[1])),  # I
    )

def identity_l(t0, t1, t2, t3, t4):
    return (tir.const(0.0, t0), tir.const(0.0, t1), tir.const(0.0, t2), tir.const(0.0, t3), tir.const(0.0, t4))
